title: feat(service-messaging,spec,cli)!: retire sys_notification_subscription — no reader ever expanded a subscription (ADR-0030 L3, amended)
body:
Closes #24923

Clause-②: yes (narrowing: `sys_notification_subscription` retires, carried into 18.x by its ADR-0087 semantic entry under 「甲」)

**Tier H.** This diff touches `docs/adr/0030-notification-platform-convergence.md`, so it stays a draft until an authorized approval (and it owes a `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` contract review). No AI seat lands it.

## What and why

The maintainer's ruling D on the parent card (decision record 6290342354, recorded 6293376907) retires `sys_notification_subscription`. ADR-0030 described it as Layer-3 audience expansion, and that expansion was never wired:

- every producer passes an explicit audience (`EmitInput.audience` is required);
- no audience member asks for subscribers, and no recipient-resolver branch reads a topic's subscriptions;
- so the Setup "Notification Subscriptions" grid let an administrator author rows that made nobody receive anything.

The ruling supersedes #9807's keep-with-a-comment decision. The table stays in deployed databases, on the `scim-provider-object-retired` / `sys-view-definition-retired` precedent. Under standing rule 「甲」 (#6015, record 6292005854) the ADR-0087 semantic entry carries the narrowing, so it ships in 18.x as a `minor` with the BREAKING banner.

## Re-measured on current main (`e4d604efd3`) before editing

| reading | `sys_notification_subscription` | control `sys_notification_preference` |
|:--|--:|--:|
| files under `packages/**/src`, tests and generated bundles excluded | 6 | 8 |
| of those, readers of the rows | **0** | 2 (`preference-resolver.ts`, `fan-out-system-context.ts`) |
| repo-wide files | 44 | 55 |
| objectui at the console pin `cf153eb2e5` | **0** | 2 files |

The 6 files are the object's own declaration, the plugin's registration and nav item, a translation-bundle comment, `PLATFORM_OBJECTS_BY_PACKAGE`, the `object.zod.ts` doc comment, and the CLI ownership inventory. None of them reads a row. The cloud repository is out of reach from this session, so its readers are **NOT MEASURED**. The entry's reason says this repo and the Studio repo only.

## What changed

- **service-messaging:** the object file and its organization-unique pin test are deleted. The object is gone from the manifest registration, from boot provisioning, from the Setup nav (`nav_notification_subscriptions`), from both export barrels and from the i18n extract config. The generated object bundles were regenerated with `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write`: 178 lines deleted, nothing added. The sibling tests drop the object. `plugin-declares-event-object.test.ts` gains an absence pin: the object is not registered and has no nav item. The same capture sees the surviving preference item, which is the vacuity control.
- **platform-objects:** the Setup nav label `nav_notification_subscriptions` is removed from the hand-written app translations (`en`, `zh-CN`, `ja-JP`, `es-ES`), along with its three recorded source hashes. This is outside the claim's listed file surface. It is the same retirement's translation half: the nav item it labelled no longer exists.
- **spec:**
  - the name leaves `PLATFORM_OBJECTS_BY_PACKAGE['service-messaging']`, pinned in `platform-object-names.test.ts` with the preference as control;
  - the `object.zod.ts` `system-data` doc comment no longer names it;
  - new semantic entry `18.sys-notification-subscription-retired.ts`, in the precedents' shape: no `RETIRED_KEYS_BY_MAJOR` entry and no D2 conversion, because no authorable spec key moves;
  - one `STEP18_RATIONALE` fragment, inserted at its sorted id position.
- **cli:** `organization-ownership-inventory.ts` keeps a row for the retired-but-present table, now census `platform-census-2026-08-31` only. It moves from fate 3 `attribution` to fate 4 `report` with `notNullExempt`, citing the ADR-0087 entry, on the `sys_scim_provider` precedent (bef7bdc). It is not `retired-before-census`, because the first census counted this object.
  - New unit pin: a `RETIRED_AFTER_FIRST_CENSUS` population, held to the same premises as `RETIRED_BEFORE_CENSUS`.
  - New integration pin in `organization-ownership-plan.integration.test.ts`: the last declared table shape, under `isolated` and `single`, plans as fate 4. The NULL row is reported, never attributed, and `notNull.willReceive` is false. Control: without the row, the plan refuses with `uninventoried-platform-table`.
- **ADR-0030:** a dated `Amended (2026-10-20 …)` entry on the status line, in the same form as the existing 2026-09-20 amendment. The L3 row is revised to preference-only, and the remaining-work "Subscription-driven fan-out" bullet is struck through and marked **Withdrawn**.
- **QA checklist:** a resolution line in `FOLLOW-UPS.md` §9d, which is append-never-rewrite, for the §9c row.
- **Census:** `scripts/platform-object-tenancy-census.json` regenerated, 85 → 84 registered.
- **Changeset:** `.changeset/24923-sys-notification-subscription-retired.md`. `minor` for service-messaging, spec and cli, `patch` for platform-objects, with the BREAKING banner, ADR-0087 disposition `registered sys-notification-subscription-retired` and the FROM → TO mapping. `content/docs/releases/` is untouched.

**Dogfood upgrade-harness fixtures: no edit, deliberately.** `fixture-18.0` and `fixture-18.0.0` are dumps of databases written by released code, and both hold the table with 0 rows. A retired-but-present table is exactly what they should hold. Regenerating them from the same refs would reproduce the same bytes. The two precedents predate the fixtures, so there is no fixture edit to mirror. The harness was run instead (below): HEAD boots over the fixture, and the ceremony plans and applies with the new fate-4 row.

Among them: `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main` (`registered sys-notification-subscription-retired (new here …)`), `check:i18n` (`all bundles in sync`), `check:platform-object-tenancy-census`, `check:spec-changes`, `check:upgrade-guide`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:platform-checklist`, `check:changeset-no-major` and `check:pm-governed-merges`.

## Acceptance notes

- `organization-ownership`'s `inventoryDigest` changes with the row. A plan file written by an earlier CLI is refused with `plan-digest-mismatch`, as for any inventory change, and the changeset says to re-plan.
- Under `single`, NULL-organization subscription rows were previously planned to the Default Organization (fate 3). They are now listed and left alone (fate 4), because nothing reads them.
- Open PR overlap was checked before opening: #24970 also edits `registry.ts.template`, in a different sorted gap. #24984 edits platform-objects' generated object bundles, which are different files from the hand-written app translations edited here.
- Historical mentions stay as written: the superseded ADR-0012 draft, ADR-0103's list, `docs/design/` and `docs/handoff/`. #24770 is not addressed here beyond its subscription half: the parent remains open for execution card ②, the template narrowing.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么:** 下线 Setup 里的「通知订阅」:对象、菜单项、导出与翻译都移除,平台对象名单去掉这个名字;数据库里的旧表原样保留不动。ADR-0030 的 L3 行与剩余工作清单按裁决 D 记一笔带日期的修订。

**为什么改:** 订阅从来没有接上线:所有发通知的地方都写明了收件人,没有任何代码读订阅表,管理员建了订阅也不会有人收到通知。你在 #24770 裁了 D:退役订阅(取代 #9807「保留并加注释」)。

**风险与代价(含回滚):** 引用了这个对象名的元数据会被提示「未知对象」;代码里 import `NotificationSubscription` 会编译失败(changeset 写明了改法)。旧表与旧数据不删,升级仪式把它列为「只报告、不归属」。回滚就是 revert 本 PR,对象与菜单即恢复,数据从未动过。

**席位意见:**

**你要做的:** 审阅 ADR-0030 的修订文字;同意则批准本 PR(Tier H,需你的批准才能落地)。
